text:
maria_marketing: Quick pass needed — final blog copy is in the doc: https://docs.google.com/example. Please quick-review the claims + benchmark language and the webinar CTA. Need legal signoff by EOD Wed. :eyes:

owen_product: Skimmed — two quick asks: 1) call out the baseline we're comparing to, 2) add a one-line note for Dedicated customers about reserved capacity.

julia_design: Hero image updated and I swapped the static screenshot for a short demo GIF (optimize_demo_v2.gif). Preview: https://img.redwood/example :camera_flash:

kevin_legal: Noted. I'll review but need the exact phrasing for the cost claim and the source of the benchmark numbers.

maria_marketing: Numbers come from the internal perf deck (linked in doc). Test: dynamic batching + 4-bit quantization vs stock fp16 p99 baseline. Pasting hero snippet below for legal edit: 

```
Hero claim:
"Redwood Optimize cuts per-token inference costs by up to 3.2x on common LLM workloads, while preserving >98% output fidelity."

CTA:
"Register for our launch webinar — see the hands-on demo and benchmark walkthrough."
```

kevin_legal: Suggest changing to: "up to 3.2x on Redwood's internal benchmark suite (March 2026)" and add a footnote link to the benchmark methodology. Also prefer ">98% output fidelity on our eval set" instead of plain ">98% output fidelity."

maria_marketing: OK will update to kevin's wording and add methodology link. Thanks.

nate_growth: For the webinar CTA — we should route registrants into the high-value demo bucket. Can we append tracking + lead tags so HubSpot routes correctly? Proposed tags: webinar:launch-2026, lead_source:blog_post, nurture_track:benchmark.

maria_marketing: Yep — adding UTMs and lead owner mapping. Draft for tracking params: 

```
UTMs:
utm_source=blog
utm_medium=post
utm_campaign=launch-optimize-2026
lead_owner=growth
lead_tag=webinar_launch_2026
```

julia_design: Tiny mobile note — hero line might be a bit long on small screens. Alternate shorter hero: 

"Cut inference costs up to 3.2x — see how in our launch webinar."

owen_product: Also add one sentence in the body about graceful degradation: "Automatic fallback to compatible model variants keeps requests online under constrained capacity."

maria_marketing: Good call, added that line to the body draft.

kevin_legal: I'll confirm legal ok by 4pm today. Once I drop thumbs, copy can go live to publish queue. Please ensure the methodology doc link is reachable from public copy or in a gated benchmark appendix.

publish-bot: Publish slot reserved: Wed 10:00 PT. Please confirm final copy 24h prior.

maria_marketing: Great — I'll make the updates now, add the methodology footnote, and re-ping for final thumbs. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
